refuter.evidence: refute-1985-132/rctl.cob (rctl-001): GO TO inside INVALID KEY transfers out (P-IK=23, no fall-through line); nested DELETE inside the outer INVALID KEY with END-DELETE: IN-NIK=00 then OUT-IK-TAIL, outer NOT INVALID KEY ignored; NOT INVALID KEY alone: success runs it with no USE, invalid key runs USE (FUSE=23) and not the phrase; NOT INVALID KEY that changes the key item (ADD 1 TO RK) runs after the operation. rseq.cob: 43 and 49 with no phrase run the USE procedure.
